correctness.rationale: For N=2m normalized unweighted path S, Chebyshev recurrence gives T_0(S)e0=e0, T_j(S)e0=e_j/sqrt(2) for 1<=j<=N-2, and T_(N-1)(S)e0=e_(N-1). Thus W_N has the explicit inverse by Chebyshev monomial coefficients. The left/right blocks of B_N observe disjoint halves before time m, so B_N is equivalent to C_m direct sum C_m with diagonal products yielding |det B_N|=2^(-(m-1)^2). For rho=1+sqrt2, Chebyshev coefficient row norms lie between (rho^j-rho^-j)/(2sqrt(j+1)) and rho^j, via unit-circle Parseval and evaluation at i; forward row norms are bounded polynomially. Inverse operator row-vs-Frobenius bounds imply kappa(W_N)^(1/N)->rho and kappa(B_N)^(1/N)->sqrt(rho). Independently constructed N=4,6,8,10 finite observation matrices and checked propagation, disjoint blocks and determinant identities; these checks support, not prove, the all-m limits.
residual_risks: Endpoint scaling and m vs N root have been checked; finite tests alone do not certify the limits.
